test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In a certain code language, 'FEATURE' is written as 'ZIUXOVY' and 'CONSULT' is written as 'WSHWOPN'. How will 'PROMISE' be written in that language?
solution:
The position of letters according to the English alphabet series:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/768ffa75a91f088695c16a6deb50b713a526fcdb17ebb80961c20654cb850baa.png] 

The pattern followed here is as follows:

'FEATURE' is written as 'ZIUXOVY'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ab13c267799098b2f3f9cf37f564c72492112385c1c7711597b6935e7de727b.png] 

And,

'CONSULT' is written as 'WSHWOPN

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/afd59e65a302dc2670c330a6c8ecc226e88a5559450a0671ec5f04991d6126df.png] 

Similarly,

'PROMISE' is written as '?'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d62bfa25518961e610a84c102bc65aea1799c2c726e06b568a3ddd4cedd38aa2.png] 

Hence, **"JVIQCWY"** is the correct answer.
